admission_pubkey.description: The join-admission key (33-byte compressed secp256k1, on the curve, not one of `signer_keys`). Every `Join` needs its signature.

denom.description: The one native denom accepted for antes and bonds (fixed for the contract's life).

remedy_keys.description: Escrow 2.1.0: REMEDY attestation keys to register at instantiation (33-byte compressed, on the curve, never a signer or admission key). They receive remedy key ids 1, 2, … in order. May be empty.

signer_keys.description: Settlement-signer keys to register at instantiation (33-byte compressed). They receive key ids 1, 2, … in order.

GameParams.description: Economic parameters. A game copies them when it is created, so a later `SetParams` never changes a game that already exists.

bond_bps.description: Bond = max(bond_floor, ante_net · bond_bps / 10_000), fixed at `Start`.

challenge_window_live_secs.description: Challenge window after a settlement is stored, per mode.

funding_period_live_secs.description: Time from `CreateGame` to the funding deadline, per mode.

liveness_window_secs.description: After a SETTLEABLE game's `window_end`, the wait before a seated wallet may `LivenessSettle` it. (Escrow 2.0.0 games also used it as the IN_PROGRESS inactivity window; 2.1.0 games have no IN_PROGRESS exit.)

resolver_timeout_secs.description: DISPUTED time after which a seated wallet may `LivenessSettle`.

subsidy_bps.description: Basis points of EVERY deposit (creator and joiners) sent to the treasury.

HexBinary.description:
This is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add hex de/serialization with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is similar to `cosmwasm_std::Binary` but uses hex. See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.
